statement: A bundle saved on its own (the `warrant-bundle.json` attachment) MUST verify by the same rules, with no page comparison.

decisions.because: Measured: every qpdf 12.4.2 re-save (four modes) dropped the marker line and kept the warrant-bundle.json attachment byte for byte (docs/measurements/2026-10-16-resave.md). Without this statement a re-saved contract could not be verified at all.

counterexample.observed: REFUSED BUNDLE_MISSING on every qpdf re-save
